summary: Created meterbill/money.py (integer arithmetic, no decimal context) and routed all rounding/fixed-place formatting through it; removed the context line from __init__.py. Batch worker threads used the default half-even context while main-thread paths used half-up, so band charges and effective price take keyword-only method parameters (half-even from batch) to keep output identical; also kept 'whole' payable from printing -0 and negative-zero handling in prorate. Differential fuzz against the original showed no output differences; tests/test_money.py added.
